feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany fell below zero for the first time since records began in 1880
entry.summary: Germany's Kaub gauge read minus 6 centimetres on 1 October, beating the previous low of 25 centimetres from October 2018. — Sources: Kaub gauge readings via logistik-heute, October 2026 · wetter.net, October 2026

entry.title: US forecasters give an 83% chance this El Niño reaches its strongest level since 1950
entry.summary: The US Climate Prediction Center's 8 October outlook puts the Niño 3.4 index at 2.1 °C above normal and gives an 83% chance October to December averages above 2.5 °C. — Sources: US Climate Prediction Center, ENSO Diagnostic Discussion, 8 October 2026

entry.title: Phoenix, Arizona is having its longest triple-digit heat season on record
entry.summary: Phoenix has had 129 days at 100 °F or more in 2026, the fifth-highest count on record. The first came on 18 March, the earliest ever, so the season is the longest on record. — Sources: KJZZ, 8 October 2026, citing the National Weather Service

entry.title: Southern California's October heat wave set date records from Los Angeles to San Diego
entry.summary: On 2 October downtown Los Angeles and Long Beach reached 103 °F and Santa Ana 105 °F, all date records. — Sources: CBS Los Angeles, 3 October 2026, citing the National Weather Service · National Weather Service San Diego, record report, 9 October 2026 · North Coast Current, 9 October 2026

entry.title: Southern China set October heat records at dozens of weather stations
entry.summary: Late-season heat on 1 and 2 October set October station records across southern China, with Qiaojia in Yunnan reaching 39.5 °C and Yongding in Fujian 39.1 °C. — Sources: The Watchers, 3 October 2026

entry.title: Correction: the 117 °F Palm Springs October record dates from 2024
entry.summary: A reading of 117 °F in Palm Springs, California on 1 October 2026, published here on 6 October, was the October 2024 record. Palm Springs peaked at 109 °F on 8 October 2026, tying the daily record. — Sources: NBC Palm Springs, 1 October 2024 and 1 October 2026 · National Weather Service San Diego, record report, 9 October 2026

entry.title: Haze closed schools in Batu Pahat, Malaysia as air quality passed 200
entry.summary: Malaysia had 28 areas with unhealthy air on 6 October. Batu Pahat in Johor reached an air pollution index of 194 that afternoon and 203 by evening, and its schools closed on 7 October. — Sources: Business Today Malaysia, 6 October 2026 · The Star, 7 October 2026

entry.title: Indonesia counted 21,708 fire hotspots in a single day
entry.summary: Indonesia's SiPongi monitoring system counted 21,708 hotspots in the 24 hours to 6 October across all confidence levels, 1,120 of them high-confidence. — Sources: Indonesia Ministry of Forestry SiPongi data via Databoks, 6 October 2026

entry.title: Correction: Singapore's PSI range of 73 to 105 was a September reading
entry.summary: A 24-hour PSI range of 73 to 105 published here on 9 October was Singapore's reading for 10 September. Verified October readings include 166 in the central region on 29 September and 130 on 6 October. — Sources: Bernama, 10 September 2026 · Bernama, 29 September 2026 · Asia News Network, 6 October 2026

entry.title: Spain recorded 5,805 heat-attributable deaths this summer, the highest in its series
entry.summary: Spain's daily mortality monitoring system attributed 5,805 deaths to heat between 15 May and 30 September 2026, the deadliest season since the series began in 2015. September alone accounted for 556. — Sources: Carlos III Health Institute MoMo system, via Bloomberg, 1 October 2026

entry.title: Maricopa County, Arizona has confirmed 275 heat deaths this year with 515 more under investigation
entry.summary: Maricopa County's confirmed heat deaths reached 275, with 515 cases still under investigation, up 76% on the same point last year. — Sources: NPR, 1 October 2026 · AZFamily, 3 October 2026

entry.title: Maternal-health workers in five countries report extreme heat harming pregnancies and newborns
entry.summary: Wellcome surveyed 1,001 maternal-health professionals in Australia, Brazil, India, the United Kingdom and Zimbabwe: 98% had treated a pregnant woman harmed by extreme heat. — Sources: Wellcome survey, via IPS News, 5 October 2026

entry.title: Qatar closed 388 work sites for breaking its summer heat-work rule
entry.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Labour closed 388 work sites for violations of Ministerial Decision 17 of 2021 recorded between 1 June and 15 September 2026. Each site was closed for three days. — Sources: Qatar News Agency, 24 September 2026

entry.title: Oman's midday work ban is set by a 2008 ministerial decision
entry.summary: Oman's Ministry of Labour cites Ministerial Decision 286 of 2008, Article 16, which stops work on construction sites and in exposed areas from 12:30 to 15:30 in June, July and August. — Sources: Oman Ministry of Labour, mol.gov.om · Oman Observer, July 2026

entry.title: Kuwait's 2026 decision also stops outdoor work in exceptional heat, humidity and dust storms
entry.summary: Kuwait's Public Authority for Manpower Decision 3 of 2026 bans open-air work from 11:00 to 16:00, 1 June to 31 August. — Sources: Mesfer Law, reproduction of PAM Decision 3 of 2026 · Al-Rai · Gulf News

entry.title: South Africa's heat rule sets a WBGT action level of 27 °C
entry.summary: South Africa's Physical Agents Regulations, enforceable since 6 September 2026, set a heat-stress action level of 27 °C WBGT and a one-hour exposure limit of 30 °C WBGT, according to the Government Gazette. — Sources: Government Gazette No. 52226, Government Notice 5952, 6 March 2025
